_readme: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill it in (on her PC the installer does it from her setup file). config.local.json is git-ignored and stays on her device only. Times are 24-hour HH:MM. An empty time turns that reminder off. The settings screen (hold the top-left corner for 3 seconds) edits the same values. window.kiosk: true opens Daybook in Edge kiosk mode (harder to leave by accident); false (the default) opens a normal window, maximized, that can be minimized and resized. voice.mode: clips = the recorded voice (bank chris), speech = the computer's own voice (rate and voiceName apply to it only). events.getReadyMinutes: the getting-ready reminder before each appointment (0 = off). character.enabled: the portrait on the today screen (false = the plain sun picture). updates: when her PC looks for a new version each night, where, and how many minutes a new version has to show it started.
